scope: Exploratory validation-only promotion screen; not significance, final-test evaluation, or a general superiority claim.

protocol.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the three seed-level equal-condition macro errors; no seed dropping.
protocol.battery_role: Required retained secondary diagnostic; not a promotion gate.
protocol.source_policy: Verify within-run bindings and within-arm core source consistency; training implementation hashes may differ across arms. No claim that recorded hashes prove correct execution.

input_binding_scope: JSON-only independent consistency checks. All existing JSON input hashes checked; checkpoint/map fingerprints compared across bound reports. No archive deserialization, fitting, inference or data-array reads.

validation_selection.policy: Uniform without replacement per observed condition; same seed/cap/order as cli.evaluate_checkpoint.

train_pool.policy: Exact verified GAN gradient-training subset; also the resampling/copula profile-fitting source.

joint_projection_directions.distribution: IID standard Gaussian coordinates, each direction normalized to Euclidean norm one
joint_projection_directions.reuse: Same directions across all conditions and methods at this profile width
joint_projection_directions.hash_encoding: Direction matrix (count, n_features), little-endian float64 C-order bytes

battery_scenario.name: hypothetical_additional_battery_charged_only_from_observed_net_export
battery_scenario.boundary_policy: Independent daily episodes; reset SOC to zero each row, report leftover SOC without future-day credit
battery_scenario.throughput_definition: Grid-facing charge input plus delivered discharge, in kWh
battery_scenario.scope: Secondary application-fidelity diagnostic; no annual-operation, cost, PV-attribution or real-hardware claim
battery_scenario.observed_data_caveat: Gross generation and any existing batteries are unknown from signed net import/export

aggregation: Equal-condition macro per seed, then mean/sampleSD over all three seeds. Paired differences are candidate minus baseline. SD is not a confidence interval.
per_condition_retention: All 64 labels retained for calibrated physical/joint/battery/utility means; all three seed-specific ramp/ACF differences retained. Complete per-seed/per-condition metrics, support/tie arrays and source histories remain in the hash-bound full source.
uncertainty: No paired candidate-versus-baseline physical or utility intervals were computed for this pilot. Baseline standalone comparisons are not pilot uncertainty.
limitations: Exploratory refinement chosen after inspecting original validation endpoints; not external preregistration or final-test evidence.

Training implementation hashes differ between arms to implement the derivative term. Evaluation/utility core sources agree; this is not a byte-identical training-code comparison.
Completed training exposure matches, but selected checkpoint epochs/prefix exposure differ under the same condition-macro selection rule.
Battery distributions are secondary diagnostics, not realized annual savings, PV attribution or hardware validation.
No exact-trace overlap under declared curation does not prove independent households or absence of near-duplicates.
